title: 3.5 mm inlet and connected-system comparison
model: Unvalidated reduced analytical gas and stochastic particle transport

protocol.wallCriterion: 10 µm first-contact fraction; upper 95% sampling bound < 5%
protocol.sampling: Uniform area over physical inlet; mass-flux weights across eight branches; independent random seeds
protocol.coagulation: Fuchs Brownian plus WZW turbulent/inertial estimate, alpha=1, monodisperse backgrounds assessed separately, no growth or depletion
protocol.airBudget: Every active 3.5 mm motive nozzle; entrained air separate; no auxiliary compressed air
protocol.systemBoundary: Parallel independent units, equal powder split. Splitter/header and downstream merge losses excluded. No series particle simulation.
protocol.feedBoundary: Corrected upstream mean velocity aligned to the actual feed; original jet field and turbulence closure retained. All affected reference and concept cases rerun.

definitions.shearPerAir: Powder/total motive air × minimum over sizes of P(outlet and maximum G ≥ 10^6 s^-1).
definitions.cleanPerAir: Powder/total motive air × minimum over sizes of E[1(outlet and high shear) exp(-Λ)].
definitions.dosePerAir: Powder/total motive air × minimum over sizes of E[1(outlet) ∫G dt].
definitions.coagulation: Mean first-sticking probability among outlet survivors; report both sizes to avoid hiding selection.
definitions.wall: Any first contact with reduced passage surface ends the trajectory; not sticking, erosion, or deposition.
definitions.intervals: Approximate 95% sampling intervals; Wilson for proportions. Minimum-over-size score intervals use Bonferroni-adjusted species bounds. These do not include model error.

limitations: New annular entrance relaxation is a conservative reduced closure, not CFD. Relaxation length 0.5–2 nozzle diameters is checked.
Angled concepts use reduced passage unions without a resolved manifold or nozzle shell; annular inlet includes its central insert but has an ideal trailing edge.
Most accumulated collision hazard lies outside the kernel validity screen; coagulation ranking is exploratory.
Two monodisperse particle backgrounds, not a measured mixed size distribution.
Series calculations require pressure, velocity, concentration and particle-history transfer. Adding independent-stage scores is invalid.
No new OpenFOAM solution or physical validation in this comparison; previous campaign CFD cases failed qualification.
Primary protocol differs from the old focused release lanes, so previous headline numbers must not be compared as matched tests.

changes: Retain terminal particle position/velocity and absolute-threshold dwell without changing integration
Annular hydraulic resistance uses actual annular area and hydraulic diameter
Study-only annular field and uniform-area release runner
provenance.runnerDifference: Later runners accept a job-specific horizon and the boundary-aligned feed closure. Original model sources and all shared gas/particle/annular functions have identical hashes. Corrected jobs supersede every affected initial job.
